entries.headline: Weekly flu toll of 219 severe cases and 44 deaths reported as multi-year high
entries.why: Multiple outlets carry the figures, variously called the highest since last season or a five-year high, and Kaohsiung coverage cites 35 local deaths. Severity framing drives demand in both the public programme and the self-pay market, and one outlet reports doctors urging chronic patients toward enhanced vaccines.
entries.headline_zh: 流感單週重症219例、死亡44例，創多年新高
entries.why_zh: 多家媒體報導相關數據，說法不一，有稱為上季以來最高，也有稱五年新高；高雄報導則指當地死亡35例。疫情嚴重性的論述同時推升公費計畫與自費市場的需求，另有一家媒體報導醫師呼籲慢性病患者接種加強型疫苗。

entries.headline: Public programme reaches about 1.91 million flu and 655,000 COVID-19 shots in eight days
entries.why: This concerns the public programme (公費): Taiwan CDC said on 6 October that uptake is ahead of last year, and Kaohsiung reports first-week uptake up more than 20%. Outlets differ on whether the '50%' figure refers to COVID-19 vaccinations or cases, so treat it with care.
entries.headline_zh: 公費計畫八天內接種流感疫苗約191萬劑、COVID-19疫苗65.5萬劑
entries.why_zh: 此項涉及公費計畫：疾管署10月6日表示接種率超越去年同期，高雄則報告首週接種量增加逾20%。各媒體對「50%」數據究竟指COVID-19疫苗接種或病例說法不一，引用時應審慎。

entries.headline: Cluster of 16 infant infections at Changhua postpartum centre puts RSV in headlines
entries.why: RSV mentions jumped to 33 this week from 3, and parent posts now discuss antibodies at birth and maternal vaccination. Funding is not stated, so it is unclear whether this pressure lands on public policy or self-pay choices.
entries.headline_zh: 彰化產後護理之家16名嬰兒群聚感染，RSV登上新聞版面
entries.why_zh: 本週RSV提及量由3則增至33則，家長貼文開始討論出生即給予抗體及孕期接種。由於未說明經費來源，尚不清楚壓力會落在公共政策或自費選擇上。

entries.headline: Posts report self-pay flu stock unavailable at Kaohsiung clinics until November
entries.why: This concerns the self-pay market (自費): a user says two clinics quoted November for supply, and another reports finding no flu vaccine left. These are thin social signals, but they surface as demand rises on severity news.
entries.headline_zh: 貼文指高雄診所自費流感疫苗須至11月才有貨
entries.why_zh: 此項涉及自費市場：一名網友表示兩家診所告知11月才到貨，另一人則稱已找不到流感疫苗。這些社群訊號雖然薄弱，但正值疫情嚴重性新聞推升需求之際浮現。

entries.headline: Clinic post promotes adjuvanted flu shot with unverified comparative protection claims
entries.why: A clinic invites the public for an adjuvanted vaccine, citing percentage and duration claims flagged as misleading; this is a compliance-sensitive issue given Taiwan's limits on advertising prescription medicines. Funding is not stated, though the invitation suggests clinic-level demand. Overall enhanced-vaccine mentions fell to 32 from 82.
entries.headline_zh: 診所貼文宣傳含佐劑流感疫苗，附未經證實的比較性保護力宣稱
entries.why_zh: 一家診所邀請民眾接種含佐劑疫苗，引用的百分比與保護期間宣稱被指具誤導性；鑑於台灣對處方藥廣告的限制，此屬法規遵循敏感議題。貼文未說明經費來源，但此邀請顯示診所層級有需求。加強型疫苗整體提及量由82則降至32則。

entries.headline: COVID-19 safety claims cluster on Threads as one adverse-event post gains traction
entries.why: Posts claim brain damage, heart disease, deaths and an 'experimental' status for COVID-19 vaccines, while a user's account of a relative's convulsions draws about 200 engagements. No brand is named, and the posts sit alongside the public joint campaign.
entries.headline_zh: COVID-19疫苗安全性說法集中於Threads，一則不良事件貼文引發關注
entries.why_zh: 貼文宣稱COVID-19疫苗導致腦損傷、心臟病、死亡，並稱其為「實驗性」疫苗；另有網友描述親屬抽搐的經歷，獲得約200次互動。貼文未指名任何品牌，且與公費合併接種宣導同時出現。

watch.text: The second stage of public flu vaccination opens, widening eligibility and testing whether supply keeps pace with severity-driven demand.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打，擴大接種對象，將考驗供應能否跟上疫情嚴重性帶動的需求。

watch.text: Watch whether self-pay flu stock reaches Kaohsiung clinics as users say clinics told them.
watch.text_zh: 觀察自費流感疫苗是否如網友轉述的診所說法，如期送達高雄診所。

watch.text: Watch whether severe-case and death counts stay at multi-year highs, and for any official follow-up on the Changhua infant cluster.
watch.text_zh: 觀察重症與死亡數是否維持多年新高，以及官方對彰化嬰兒群聚事件的後續說明。

qa.q: Is there an official supply problem in the public programme?
qa.a: No official notice of a shortage has appeared. Taiwan CDC reports uptake ahead of last year, and Taoyuan added 11,000 doses for school staff. Shortage reports so far come from social posts, mainly about self-pay stock in Kaohsiung.
qa.q_zh: 公費計畫是否有官方承認的供應問題？
qa.a_zh: 目前未見官方發布短缺通知。疾管署表示接種率超越去年同期，桃園並為學校教職員追加11,000劑。至今短缺消息均來自社群貼文，主要涉及高雄的自費疫苗庫存。

qa.q: What is the conversation saying about enhanced flu vaccines this week?
qa.a: Volume is down: enhanced mentions fell to 32 from 82 and high-dose to 11 from 20. One outlet reports doctors urging chronic patients toward enhanced vaccines, a Hsinchu report references them, and a clinic post making comparative claims has been flagged as misleading.
qa.q_zh: 本週關於加強型流感疫苗的討論內容為何？
qa.a_zh: 聲量下滑：加強型提及量由82則降至32則，高劑量由20則降至11則。一家媒體報導醫師呼籲慢性病患者接種加強型疫苗，一則新竹報導有所提及，另有一則含比較性宣稱的診所貼文被指具誤導性。

qa.q: Is RSV becoming a live issue?
qa.a: Yes, from a low base: mentions rose to 33 from 3, driven by the Changhua postpartum-centre cluster. Parent posts discuss infant antibodies at birth and maternal vaccination. No official RSV notice has appeared, and funding is not stated.
qa.a_zh: 是，但基數偏低：提及量由3則增至33則，主要受彰化產後護理之家群聚事件帶動。家長貼文討論嬰兒出生即給予抗體及孕期接種。目前未見官方RSV相關通知，亦未說明經費來源。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: The official joint launch confirmed that enhanced flu vaccines go first to long-term care residents aged 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax COVID-19 vaccines are supplied.
policy_notes.why_zh: 官方聯合開打確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，並同時供應Moderna與Novavax COVID-19疫苗。

policy_notes.why: Taiwan CDC's statement that uptake is ahead of last year frames the programme as a success and adds urgency before holiday travel.
policy_notes.why_zh: 疾管署表示接種率超越去年同期，將計畫定調為成功，並在連假出遊前增添緊迫感。

misinfo.claim: A clinic promotes an adjuvanted flu vaccine as giving 20-30% better protection with 12-month coverage
misinfo.note: This comparative claim to the public is compliance-sensitive under prescription-medicine advertising rules; the licence holder should review it and others should avoid amplifying it.
misinfo.claim_zh: 診所宣傳含佐劑流感疫苗保護力高出20-30%，保護期達12個月
misinfo.note_zh: 此類對民眾的比較性宣稱在處方藥廣告規範下屬法規遵循敏感事項；許可證持有者應審視，其他各方應避免擴散。

misinfo.claim: Repeated COVID-19 shots cause brain atrophy, pineal calcification and cognitive decline
misinfo.note: Monitor for spread and keep regulator safety-monitoring references ready for stakeholder enquiries; no brand is named.
misinfo.claim_zh: 重複接種COVID-19疫苗導致腦萎縮、松果體鈣化及認知衰退
misinfo.note_zh: 監測擴散情形，並備妥主管機關安全監測資料以回應利害關係人詢問；未指名任何品牌。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines are 'experimental' and skipped phase 3 trials
misinfo.note: Prepare factual licensure-history briefing material for health-professional and media enquiries rather than engaging individual posts.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗屬「實驗性」且跳過第三期試驗
misinfo.note_zh: 準備有關核准歷程的事實性簡報資料，以回應醫療人員及媒體詢問，而非逐一回應個別貼文。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines cause heart disease, deaths and regional virus resurgence, and saved no lives
misinfo.note: These are low-engagement anecdotes and conspiracy reposts; track them without amplifying.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗導致心臟病、死亡及區域病毒再起，且未拯救任何生命
misinfo.note_zh: 此類為低互動的個人經驗及陰謀論轉貼；持續追蹤但不擴散。

misinfo.claim: Giving flu and COVID-19 shots together causes an 'immune storm'
misinfo.note: This targets the joint campaign; check that official co-administration guidance is easy to point to if it grows.
misinfo.claim_zh: 流感與COVID-19疫苗同時接種會引發「免疫風暴」
misinfo.note_zh: 此說法針對合併接種宣導；若聲量擴大，應確認官方同時接種指引易於引用。

misinfo.claim: Vaccines contain viruses and local calls urging seniors to vaccinate endanger them
misinfo.note: This is an isolated post; no action beyond tracking.
misinfo.claim_zh: 疫苗含有病毒，地方呼籲長者接種反而危害長者
misinfo.note_zh: 此為單一貼文；僅需追蹤，無需其他行動。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV conversation jumped from 3 to 33 items week on week, driven by reports of a 16-infant cluster at a Changhua postpartum care centre and parent posts about prenatal RSV vaccination and wanting newborns to have RSV antibodies at birth. No item names nirsevimab or Beyfortus, and no official notice on infant RSV appeared.
products.implication: Infant RSV is moving from a niche parent topic to a news story about postpartum care settings, which may prompt questions to health authorities about infant protection options before any official position exists.
products.action: Prepare a neutral evidence and policy briefing on infant RSV burden and prevention options for neonatology, paediatric and obstetric societies; monitor any health bureau or Taiwan CDC response to the cluster and avoid public comment on the specific outbreak.
who: Postpartum care centre operators and associations
products.signal_zh: RSV討論量較上週由3則增至33則，主要受彰化產後護理之家16名嬰兒群聚報導，以及家長討論孕期RSV疫苗接種、希望新生兒出生即具RSV抗體的貼文帶動。沒有任何內容提及nirsevimab或Beyfortus，也未見官方有關嬰兒RSV的通知。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV正從小眾家長話題轉變為涉及產後護理機構的新聞事件，可能在官方立場確立前，引發外界向衛生主管機關詢問嬰兒保護選項。
products.action_zh: 為新生兒科、兒科及婦產科醫學會準備中立的嬰兒RSV疾病負擔與預防選項實證及政策簡報；監測衛生局或疾管署對群聚事件的回應，並避免公開評論此特定疫情。

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), enhanced flu vaccine in public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: High-dose mentions fell from 20 to 11 and enhanced-vaccine mentions from 82 to 32 despite record severity coverage. Taiwan CDC's launch notice prioritises enhanced vaccines for long-term care residents 65+; one doctor urged chronic patients toward enhanced vaccines, an expert piece urged recombinant vaccine for high-risk elders, and a clinic post made comparative efficacy claims for an adjuvanted vaccine. No item names Efluelda.
products.implication: The first-year enhanced-vaccine story risks going quiet before rollout results are known, while competing technologies and loose comparative claims shape how the enhanced category is discussed.
products.action: Engage long-term care and geriatric stakeholders on rollout experience in facilities, prepare factual material for health professionals on request, and keep a holding line ready on category comparisons and advertising compliance.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），公費提供65歲以上長照機構住民的加強型流感疫苗
products.signal_zh: 儘管疫情嚴重性報導創新高，高劑量提及量仍由20則降至11則，加強型疫苗由82則降至32則。疾管署開打公告將加強型疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民；一名醫師呼籲慢性病患者接種加強型疫苗，一篇專家文章呼籲高風險長者接種重組疫苗，另有診所貼文對含佐劑疫苗提出比較性效力宣稱。沒有任何內容提及Efluelda。
products.implication_zh: 首年加強型疫苗議題恐在接種成果揭曉前即沉寂，而競爭技術與鬆散的比較性宣稱正左右加強型類別的討論方向。
products.action_zh: 與長照及老年醫學利害關係人交流機構內接種經驗，應要求為醫療人員準備事實性資料，並備妥有關類別比較及廣告法規遵循的回應口徑。
who_zh: 老年醫學及感染症醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: pertussis booster for adults and pregnancy
products.signal: Little direct signal: Tdap volume rose from 0 to 12, coming from medical-society messages urging vaccines for people with chronic lung disease. None of the top items this week discusses Tdap; a pregnancy vaccine question post asks only about RSV, flu and COVID-19.
products.implication: Pertussis protection is entering the chronic lung disease conversation through medical societies, but it is absent from prenatal discussion, where parents focus on other vaccines.
products.action: Track the medical-society chronic lung disease messaging and prepare adult and maternal pertussis background material for respiratory and obstetric stakeholders; no public-facing activity indicated.
products.sub_zh: 成人及孕期百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 直接訊號有限：Tdap聲量由0則增至12則，來自醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗的訊息。本週熱門內容均未討論Tdap；一則孕期疫苗提問貼文僅詢問RSV、流感及COVID-19疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 百日咳保護正透過醫學會進入慢性肺病討論，但在產前討論中缺席，家長關注的是其他疫苗。
products.action_zh: 追蹤醫學會的慢性肺病訊息，並為胸腔及婦產科利害關係人準備成人及孕產婦百日咳背景資料；目前不建議進行對外公開活動。
who_zh: 胸腔暨重症醫學相關學會

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Novavax appears only in Taiwan CDC's 1 October launch notice, which confirms its supply in the public programme. No news coverage or posts this week name Novavax. Brand-agnostic COVID-19 posts circulate false safety claims, including brain damage and an 'experimental vaccine' framing.
products.implication: Brand visibility rests entirely on the official programme description, so public questions about its availability are likely to go to clinics and health bureaus rather than media.
products.action: Keep accurate availability and product information ready for health bureaus and vaccinating clinics on request, and maintain issue readiness for brand-agnostic safety claims without engaging individual posts.
products.signal_zh: Novavax僅出現在疾管署10月1日開打公告中，確認其於公費計畫中供應。本週無任何新聞或貼文提及Novavax。未指名品牌的COVID-19貼文流傳不實安全性說法，包括腦損傷及「實驗性疫苗」等論述。
products.implication_zh: 品牌能見度完全依賴官方計畫說明，因此民眾對供應情形的疑問可能流向診所與衛生局，而非媒體。
products.action_zh: 備妥正確的供應及產品資訊，應衛生局及合約接種院所要求提供，並對未指名品牌的安全性說法保持議題準備，不逐一回應個別貼文。

issues.title: Stock pressure as public second stage and self-pay demand converge
issues.note: Posts already report clinics without self-pay flu stock until November and record weekly severity is driving demand, so access complaints may grow when eligibility widens.
issues.title_zh: 公費第二階段與自費需求疊加，庫存承壓
issues.note_zh: 已有貼文指診所自費流感疫苗須至11月才有貨，且單週疫情嚴重性創新高正推升需求，擴大接種對象後，接種可近性的抱怨可能增加。

issues.title: Postpartum care centre RSV cluster prompts infant protection questions
issues.note: Media coverage of a 16-infant cluster could lead to calls on authorities for infection-control action or infant RSV prevention policy; stakeholders will look for evidence, not brand voices.
issues.title_zh: 產後護理之家RSV群聚引發嬰兒保護疑問
issues.note_zh: 媒體報導16名嬰兒群聚事件，可能引發要求主管機關採取感染管制措施或制定嬰兒RSV預防政策的呼聲；利害關係人將尋求實證，而非品牌發聲。

issues.title: Comparative efficacy claims on enhanced flu vaccines draw scrutiny
issues.note: A clinic post promoting an adjuvanted vaccine with percentage claims was flagged as misleading; similar posts could invite regulatory attention to the whole enhanced category.
issues.title_zh: 加強型流感疫苗的比較性效力宣稱受到檢視
issues.note_zh: 一則以百分比宣稱宣傳含佐劑疫苗的診所貼文被指具誤導性；類似貼文可能使主管機關關注整個加強型類別。

self_pay.title: Self-pay flu stock lagging at clinics
self_pay.note: A Kaohsiung user reports two clinics said self-pay flu vaccine would not arrive until November, and another person posts that no flu vaccine was left when they asked; these are unverified posts.
self_pay.title_zh: 診所自費流感疫苗到貨延遲
self_pay.note_zh: 一名高雄網友表示兩家診所告知自費流感疫苗須至11月才到貨，另有一人發文稱詢問時已無流感疫苗；以上均為未經證實的貼文。

self_pay.title: Clinic promotion of enhanced vaccine with comparative claims
self_pay.note: A clinic invites people to get an adjuvanted flu vaccine with protection and duration claims flagged as misleading; funding is not stated but the post targets walk-in demand.
self_pay.title_zh: 診所以比較性宣稱宣傳加強型疫苗
self_pay.note_zh: 一家診所邀請民眾接種含佐劑流感疫苗，其保護力與保護期間宣稱被指具誤導性；貼文未說明經費來源，但鎖定現場掛號需求。

self_pay.title: RSV infant protection discussed without price or stock detail
self_pay.note: Parents post about choosing RSV protection for newborns and receiving RSV vaccination in pregnancy, but no item mentions prices, clinic stock or funding for RSV products or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV保護受討論，但無價格或庫存細節
self_pay.note_zh: 家長發文討論為新生兒選擇RSV保護及孕期接種RSV疫苗，但沒有任何內容提及RSV產品或Tdap的價格、診所庫存或經費來源。

self_pay.title: Self-pay mentioned only in passing in news
self_pay.note: Holiday vaccination site coverage and a doctor's warning piece mention self-paid vaccination without giving prices or availability.
self_pay.note_zh: 連假接種站報導及一篇醫師警示文章提及自費接種，但未提供價格或供應資訊。
